column1: # dr_matrix_legacy_compound_comparison.tsv - CTD vs ChEMBL ranking comparison
#   - ctd_n_targets_27panel: the original CTD study-volume count (27-gene panel) from the 2026-10-05 compound-dr-target-matrix.tsv (read-only, not modified).
#   - chembl_n_genes_bound_43panel / chembl_n_effectors_bound / chembl_best_pchembl: measured ChEMBL binding evidence for the matched compound against the extended 43-gene panel, AT ANY POTENCY.
#   - chembl_n_genes_bound_pchembl_ge6 / chembl_n_effectors_bound_pchembl_ge6: the same counts gated to pchembl_value >= 6 (<= 1 uM), the conventional 'active' cut.
#   - match_method: how the compound name was resolved to a ChEMBL molecule id (exact_pref_name, chembl_search, or unmatched).
#   - Empty numeric fields mean the compound could NOT be matched to a ChEMBL molecule id - this is absence of a match, not a measured zero. Do not treat blank as 0.
#   - A low chembl_n_genes_bound_43panel does not mean the compound lacks pharmacological activity - it means ChEMBL has not measured it against these specific targets.
#   - An UNGATED chembl_n_genes_bound_43panel can be as weak as >100 uM - use the pchembl_ge6 columns for potency-aware comparison.
#   - Rows lacking a pchembl_value for a gene are EXCLUDED from the gated counts - this is missing/unconverted unit data, not evidence of weak binding.
# SOURCE: ChEMBL REST API (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chembl/api/data), live pull.
# WARNING: absence of a ChEMBL activity for a gene/compound pair means "not measured in ChEMBL", NOT "no interaction".
